access_boundary: This record represents the GPT-5.4 release whose API page identifies gpt-5.4-2026-03-05 as the fixed snapshot behind the gpt-5.4 alias; the API deprecation page carries no retirement entry for this base line as of review. ChatGPT, the GPT-5.4 Mini, Nano, Pro, and invite-only Cyber siblings, later GPT releases, fine-tuned derivatives, and the OpenAI API platform itself are separate service, application, or model boundaries.
strengths: OpenAI documents a dated snapshot that applications can pin instead of relying only on the alias
Two managed serving paths: the first-party developer API with a 1M-token context window and computer-use tool support, and Azure Foundry, whose reasoning-models page names gpt-5.4
tradeoffs: No developer-published weights are available for self-operation or independent deployment
Access, quotas, and lifecycle remain controlled by the managed APIs rather than the model operator
